purpose: Replace flat V1 Hyperfocus ambient choices with six environmental sound families, each with soft/deep/intense levels, without allowing music-like outputs.

sourcePolicy.preferredSource: free real-world nature recordings bundled in public/sounds/hyperfocus
sourcePolicy.currentProvider: Mixkit and BigSoundBank free sound effects
sourcePolicy.aiGenerationPolicy: Generated pilots stay quarantined until objective QC and audible review prove they are non-musical, loop-safe environmental beds.
disallowedAudioTraits: artist references or pop/music genre steering
vocals, spoken words, lyrics, whispering, or humming
melody, beat, drums, instruments, hooks, risers, drops, intros, or outros
sudden alarms, notification-like transients, clipping, harsh peaks, or scare moments
social chatter as a visible V2 nature-family option

assetPolicy.loudness: quiet focus bed; RMS/peak/clipping/seam metrics must pass scripts/check-hyperfocus-audio-assets.cjs; no harsh transient spikes; no fatigue after human listen-through

fullPackAllowedOnlyAfter: source license and local bundled path are recorded
decode/probe confirms readable 2ch/48000Hz MP3 around 30 seconds
manifest sha256 and bytes match local files
soft/deep/intense progression passes decoded MP3 metric test
package report passes source public, web dist, iOS Capacitor, iOS simulator app, Android Capacitor, Android debug APK, Tauri dist, and macOS Tauri app targets
audible review confirms no song, melody, beat, vocals, intelligible speech, harsh foreground distractions, or fatigue-inducing spikes

levels.prompt: Generate a 30-second seamless loop, field-recording environmental soundscape for concentration. This is a nature forest soundscape, not a song. Scene: wind in the forest canopy, soft leaves, airy organic room for attention, minimal wildlife. Level: soft, delicate, close and calm. Keep the texture steady from first second to last second. No vocals, no lyrics, no melody, no beat, no drums, no instruments, no song structure. No intro, no ending, no riser, no dramatic transition, no scored drama. Make it calm, local, organic, loop-safe, and suitable for long focus sessions.
levels.normalization: strict local 30-second MP3 loop; original Mixkit source was trimmed/loop-tail-normalized for bundled runtime QC
